enriched_description: Close-fitting pullover shirt constructed from knit fabric with a soft stretchy texture. Features a round or V-shaped neckline, short or long sleeves with hemmed cuffs, and a straight hem at the bottom. The knit material drapes smoothly over the torso with visible vertical ribbing or fine jersey knit texture. Fabric weight ranges from lightweight cotton to heavier blended materials. Shoulder seams align with natural shoulder line, and the body length typically extends to the hip line. Surface may feature solid colors, printed graphics, or team logos.

Flat rectangular puzzle consisting of numerous interlocking cardboard pieces that assemble to form a complete printed image. Individual pieces have irregular shapes with characteristic tabs and blanks (knobs and holes) along edges that interlock with adjacent pieces. The printed surface displays a continuous photograph or illustration when assembled, with visible cut lines between pieces when disassembled. Piece edges have a matte cardboard texture with glossy printed image surface. Total assembled dimensions typically range from 30x40 cm to 50x70 cm depending on piece count.

Small two-wheeled passenger cart with a covered seat compartment designed to be pulled by a single person. Features a lightweight wooden or bamboo frame with two large spoked wheels positioned on either side of a cushioned seat. A fabric or canvas canopy extends over the passenger area, supported by thin metal or wooden poles. Two long shafts extend forward for the puller to grip. The seat compartment has a low backrest and side panels, often decorated with painted patterns. Overall proportions show a compact passenger area approximately 1 meter wide with wheels extending slightly beyond the seat width.

Manual input device consisting of a vertical cylindrical or ergonomic handle mounted on a rectangular or square base. The handle pivots freely in two axes (forward-backward and left-right), with a spring-loaded centering mechanism returning it to neutral position. Base unit houses electronic sensors and connects via cable or wireless receiver. Surface features include trigger buttons on the handle grip, additional buttons on the base, and sometimes a throttle lever on the side. Handle height approximately 10-15 cm above base, with textured rubber or plastic grip surface for secure handling.

Loose T-shaped robe with wide flowing sleeves and a straight-cut body, traditionally worn with an overlapping front closure secured by a wide sash (obi). Constructed from silk, cotton, or synthetic fabric with a smooth lustrous surface. The garment features straight seams with no shoulder shaping, creating a rectangular silhouette when laid flat. Sleeve width is notably broad, extending well beyond the arm when worn. Fabric displays elaborate printed or dyed patterns including floral motifs, geometric designs, or seasonal scenes. Length extends to ankle level, with excess fabric folded at the waist.

Protective pad designed to cover and cushion the knee joint during athletic activity. Consists of a padded insert encased in a flexible fabric or synthetic shell, secured by elastic straps or a sleeve-style design. The padded surface is contoured to fit the kneecap shape, with a rounded dome profile approximately 2-3 cm thick. Outer shell material ranges from neoprene to hard plastic cap over foam padding. Elastic straps with hook-and-loop fasteners wrap behind the knee for adjustable fit. Surface texture varies from smooth synthetic to textured grip material.

Compact fastening formed by interwoven loops and turns of rope, cord, or string tied upon itself or around another object. The knot structure shows overlapping strands creating a dense tangled mass with visible crossing points where the rope intersects itself. Rope material may be braided nylon, twisted hemp, or woven synthetic fiber with characteristic surface texture. The knot body is approximately 2-3 times the diameter of the rope itself, with free ends extending outward. Common configurations include overhand loops, figure-eight patterns, and interlocking hitches with visible tension points.

Lightweight knee-length coat constructed from white cotton or polyester blend fabric with a smooth matte surface. Features a front button closure with a row of white buttons, a notched lapel collar, and long sleeves with buttoned cuffs. Two or three patch pockets are positioned on the front lower body, with an additional chest pocket on the left side. The coat has a straight cut with side vents or a center back vent for ease of movement. Fabric weight is medium, providing a crisp drape. Length extends to mid-thigh or just above the knee.

Spoon-shaped serving vessel with a deep hemispherical bowl and a long straight handle. The bowl has a smooth polished metal surface (stainless steel, aluminum, or silver-plated) with a capacity of 60-240 ml. Bowl diameter ranges from 7-12 cm with a depth of 4-7 cm. The handle extends 25-35 cm from the bowl, terminating in a loop or hook for hanging storage. Handle cross-section may be round, flat, or slightly curved for ergonomic grip. Surface shows reflective metallic finish with visible manufacturing seams at the bowl-handle junction.

Decorative shade structure designed to mount over a light bulb, typically conical, drum-shaped, or bell-shaped. Constructed from fabric, paper, glass, or plastic stretched over a wire frame. The shade has an open bottom and top, with the top opening smaller to fit over the lamp fixture. Surface texture depends on material: fabric shades show woven texture with possible printed patterns, paper shades have a smooth matte finish, glass shades are transparent or frosted with smooth glossy surface. Height ranges from 15-40 cm with bottom diameter of 20-50 cm.
